name: Write multiple files
description:
**Conversation summary (5 lines)**

1. You asked for bulk-saving multiple `CodeViewer` code blocks at once via a new `writeMultiple` files API endpoint — I added `POST /api/files/write-multiple` to `src/api/modules/files.js`.
2. I then added selection UI to `ChatEntry.vue`: per-block checkboxes, an **All** toggle with indeterminate state, and a "Save N files" action bar.
3. You reported the checkboxes were invisible in Files/Review mode; I initially assumed it was only the `showFileView`/`showPRView` gating and made the bar render in both views.
4. Root cause found: `extractCodeBlocks()` returns **`filePath`** (camelCase), but my code read `file_path`/`path` — every block was filtered out, leaving `selectableCodeBlocks` empty; I added a single `blockPath()` resolver plus `codeBlockKeys` aligned 1:1 with rendered blocks.
5. Final diffs touched `ChatEntry.vue` (selection state, bulk save, fixed `{ file, content }` fallback emit) and added inline checkboxes to `MessageFileView.vue` and `MessagePRView.vue`; open follow-ups are the dead `linkedFilesNotInBlocks()` dedupe and unifying `CodeViewer`'s per-file Save with the bulk status line.

messages.content: In files view: allow to select multiple CodeViewers and save all content at once with the new files endpoint
Add teh changes in ChatEntry to select the code blocks to save and add a "All" select option.

I'll add a self-contained selection toolbar to `ChatEntry.vue` — per-code-block checkboxes, an **All** toggle (with indeterminate state), and a bulk “Save N files” action that uses the new `writeMultiple` endpoint when block content is resolvable, falling back to the existing `save-file` flow otherwise. @@ CODX_FILE @@ path: src/components/ChatEntry.vue language: vue change_type: update encoding: text @@ CODX_CONTENT @@ @@ CODX_END @@ --- ## What changed | Piece | Detail | |---|---| | **Selection state** | `selectedCodeBlockKeys: []` + `savingCodeBlocks` + `codeBlockSaveStatus` in `data()` — lives in `ChatEntry`, so `MessageFileView` / `CodeViewer` stay stateless | | **`selectableCodeBlocks`** | Normalises `prViewCodeBlocks` into `{ key, path, name, block }`, skipping blocks without a `file_path` | | **“All” toggle** | `toggleSelectAllCodeBlocks(checked)` + `allCodeBlocksSelected` / `someCodeBlocksSelected` driving `:checked` and `:indeterminate.prop` | | **Per-block chips** | One checkbox chip per code block (only rendered when >1 block), with the file name and full path in `title` | | **Bulk save** | `saveSelectedCodeBlocks()` → uses `api.files.writeMultiple([{path, content}])` when every block resolves path+content; otherwise replays the existing `save-file` emit per block | | **Failure handling** | `applyCodeBlockSaveResult()` clears only successful keys — failed files stay selected so they can be retried, with an inline `N of M failed` message | | **Stale selection guard** | `watch: selectableCodeBlocks` prunes keys no longer present (streaming updates, edits) | ## Things worth confirming against `MessageFileView.vue` 1. **Block shape** — I resolve `path` from `file_path || path` and `content` from `content || code`. If the extractor uses something else (e.g. `text`), add it to `resolveCodeBlockFile` — otherwise it silently falls back to the per-file `save-file` emit. 2. **Duplicate paths** — keys are `path#index`, so two blocks for the same file are independently selectable. On bulk save both are sent; if the backend needs de-duping (last-wins), I'd collapse them in `saveSelectedCodeBlocks`. 3. **`writeMultiple` availability** — guarded with `!!api?.files?.writeMultiple`, and the API module still needs the `writeMultiple` method (added in the previous turn) for the fast path.

I can NOT see where in the ChatEntry the check box to select code blocks to be written.
Explain latest changes.
I expect that when we switch to review mode and only code blocks are shown we must allow multiple/all code blocks and send them to write all

## Why the checkboxes were invisible Short answer: **the toolbar was never rendered in review mode** — it was gated behind `showFileView`, which is a *different* flag than the one the Review button sets. Walking the current `ChatEntry.vue`: | Trigger | Handler | Flag set | What renders | |---|---|---|---| | **Files** button (`fa-file-code`, `data-tip="Files"`) | `toggleFileView()` | `showFileView = true` | `` **+ the checkbox toolbar** | | **Review** button (`fa-code-branch`, `data-tip="Review"`) | `togglePRView()` | `showPRView = true` | `` **only** | Two things combined to hide it: 1. The toolbar's guard was literally `v-if="showFileView && !srcView && !showDiff && !showPRView && !showAttachments && selectableCodeBlocks.length"` — it **explicitly excluded** `showPRView`. So in review mode the condition was always false. 2. The two flags are mutually exclusive: `togglePRView()` does `this.showFileView = false`, and `toggleFileView()` does `this.showPRView = false`. There was no mode in which both were true, so the toolbar could never appear while reviewing. A **second, silent bug** was in the save path: `saveSelectedCodeBlocks()` read `res?.results` and looked for `r.ok === false`, but `POST /files/write-multiple` returns `{ written, failed, total_files, total_written }`. So even in Files mode, failures were never reported — the selection was cleared as if everything succeeded. ## What I changed | Change | Detail | |---|---| | Toolbar visibility | `v-if="(showFileView || showPRView) && !srcView && !showDiff && !showAttachments && selectableCodeBlocks.length"` — the selection bar now shows above **both** the Files view and the Review view | | Response contract | `saveSelectedCodeBlocks()` now maps the real `{ written, failed }` payload (`failed` = `[{ path, error }]`) instead of the non-existent `results[].ok` | | Duplicate paths | Blocks that resolve to the same `path` are collapsed (last wins) before the request, since the backend writes sequentially | | Failed files | Only successfully written blocks are removed from the selection — failed ones stay ticked so a retry is one click | The **All** checkbox (with indeterminate state) and the per-block chips were already implemented — they will now simply appear in review mode as well, since that whole block was already rendered above `` **and** above `` in DOM order. @@ CODX_FILE @@ path: src/components/ChatEntry.vue language: vue change_type: update encoding: text @@ CODX_CONTENT @@ @@ CODX_END @@ ## How to see it now 1. Click the **Review** button (`fa-code-branch`) or **Files** button (`fa-file-code`) on an assistant message that contains fenced blocks with file paths. 2. Above the code list you'll now get the bar: `☐ All · 0/3 selected · Clear · Save 0 files`. 3. Tick **All** (or individual chips), then **Save N files** → one `POST /api/files/write-multiple` → success/failure line appears inline; failed files stay ticked. ## Still open (needs files I can't see) - **`MessagePRView.vue` / `MessageFileView.vue`** — if you'd rather have the checkbox **inline on each code block header** instead of the chip row above, that's a `props`/`emit` change in those components. Right now selection lives entirely in `ChatEntry`, which is why the controls are grouped in one bar rather than on each block. - **`$service.chat.extractCodeBlocksFromMessage`** — if blocks expose their code as `text` (or something else) instead of `content`/`code`, `resolveCodeBlockFile()` returns `null` and the code silently falls back to the per-block `save-file` emit. Worth confirming once.

Let me explain, attaching screenshots. When clicking in files there are NO files selector, nor multiple files actions. review how chat entry shows the message files and how we can add the multi-files actions like "save"

Let me read the real files (the search index may be stale).## Diagnosis — why the selector never appeared I traced the real data path. It's a **field-name mismatch**, not a layout problem: | Layer | What it produces / consumes | |---|---| | `src/utils/codeBlockExtractor.js` → `extractCodeBlocks()` | `{ language, **filePath**, content, fileName }` | | `src/service/chat.js` → `extractCodeBlocksFromMessage()` | returns `extractCodeBlocks(message.content)` — so blocks carry **`filePath`** (camelCase) | | `ChatEntry.vue` → `selectableCodeBlocks` | `const path = block?.file_path \|\| block?.path` → **`undefined`** | Every block got filtered out → `selectableCodeBlocks.length === 0` → the toolbar `v-if` was always false → **no "All", no checkboxes, no bulk Save**. Same bug in `resolveCodeBlockFile()`. Two secondary bugs found while reviewing: 1. **Wrong fallback payload** — the non-bulk path emitted the raw block to `save-file`, but `Chat.vue::onSaveFile({ file, content })` expects `{ file, content }`. 2. **Index drift** — `selectableCodeBlocks` drops blocks without a path, so aligning keys by *filtered* index would mis-select rows in `MessageFileView`/`MessagePRView` (which render the unfiltered `prViewCodeBlocks`). ## What I changed | File | Change | |---|---| | `ChatEntry.vue` | Fixed path resolution (`filePath` → `file_path` → `path`); added `codeBlockKeys` aligned **1:1 with rendered blocks** so checkboxes never drift; bar now renders in **both** Files and Review views; child views receive `selectionKeys` / `selectedKeys`; fixed fallback `save-file` payload | | `chat/MessageFileView.vue` | Row wrap: **inline checkbox per code block** + `toggle-select` emit | | `chat/MessagePRView.vue` | Same inline checkbox per code block | Per the design system: selection state stays **only** in `ChatEntry` (children stay dumb/presentational), touch target is a `checkbox-sm` inside a 40px row, and the bar carries semantic states (0 selected = disabled, saved = success, failed = error). @@ CODX_FILE @@ path: src/components/ChatEntry.vue language: vue change_type: update encoding: text @@ CODX_CONTENT @@ @@ CODX_END @@ | File Path | Action | Component / Section | Change Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `src/components/ChatEntry.vue` | Modify | `blockPath` (new) | Single source of truth for the block path: `filePath` → `file_path` → `path`. **This is the root-cause fix.** | | `src/components/ChatEntry.vue` | Modify | `codeBlockKeys` (new) | Keys aligned 1:1 with the rendered `prViewCodeBlocks`; `null` for blocks with no path so child checkboxes never shift rows. | | `src/components/ChatEntry.vue` | Modify | `selectableCodeBlocks` | Now resolves `filePath`, keeps `index`, includes `key/path/name`. | | `src/components/ChatEntry.vue` | Modify | `showCodeBlockSelection` (new) | Toolbar visible in Files **and** Review views. | | `src/components/ChatEntry.vue` | Modify | `resolveCodeBlockFile` | Uses `blockPath()`; returns `null` when content isn't a string. | | `src/components/ChatEntry.vue` | Modify | `saveSelectedCodeBlocks` | Fallback emit fixed to `{ file, content }` (matches `Chat.vue::onSaveFile`); dedupes by path for the bulk call. | @@ CODX_FILE @@ path: src/components/chat/MessageFileView.vue language: vue change_type: update encoding: text @@ CODX_CONTENT @@ @@ CODX_END @@ | File Path | Action | Component / Section | Change Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `src/components/chat/MessageFileView.vue` | Modify | `template` (code blocks) | Each `CodeViewer` row is now wrapped with a 44px-tall selectable checkbox; `min-w-0 flex-1` keeps the editor layout intact. | | `src/components/chat/MessageFileView.vue` | Modify | `props` / `emits` | Added `selectionKeys`, `selectedKeys`, `savingSelection` props and the `toggle-select` emit. | | `src/components/chat/MessageFileView.vue` | Modify | `isSelected(index)` (new) | Maps the rendered index → selection key → selected state. | @@ CODX_FILE @@ path: src/components/chat/MessagePRView.vue language: vue change_type: update encoding: text @@ CODX_CONTENT @@ @@ CODX_END @@ | File Path | Action | Component / Section | Change Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `src/components/chat/MessagePRView.vue` | Modify | `template` (code blocks) | Inline selection checkbox per file, mirroring the Files view. | | `src/components/chat/MessagePRView.vue` | Modify | `props` / `emits` | Added `selectionKeys`, `selectedKeys`, `savingSelection` + `toggle-select`. | | `src/components/chat/MessagePRView.vue` | Modify | `isSelected(index)` (new) | Index → selection key → checked state. | | `src/components/chat/MessagePRView.vue` | Unchanged | header | Only wrapped in `flex-wrap` so the branch badge doesn't overflow on narrow panels. | --- ## What you should now see 1. Click **Files** (`fa-file-code`) → a bar appears above the list: `☐ All · 0/3 selected · Clear · Save 0 files`, and **each code block has its own checkbox on the left**. 2. Tick files individually, or tick **All** (indeterminate state when partially selected). 3. Press **Save N files** → one `POST /api/files/write-multiple` → inline `N files saved` (success) or `X of N failed` (failed files stay ticked for retry). 4. Same behaviour in **Review** mode (`fa-code-branch`). ## Anti-patterns avoided - ❌ **Selection state inside `CodeViewer`** — it stays a dumb view; all state lives in `ChatEntry`, so there's exactly one source of truth across both views. - ❌ **Index-based selection without a mapping** — `codeBlockKeys` is aligned to the *rendered* array, so a block without a path hides its checkbox rather than shifting every selection below it. - ❌ **Clearing the whole selection on failure** — only successfully written keys are dropped. ## Accessibility - Every checkbox has an `aria-label` / `tooltip` naming the exact file it selects. - Checkboxes are inside `
